Class Student

java.lang.Object
Models.Entities.User
Models.Entities.Student
public class Student extends User
Represents a student user in the Internship Placement Management System. Students can browse internships, submit applications, accept placements, and request withdrawals.

Key features:

  • Can apply for up to 3 internships simultaneously
  • Year 1-2 students can only apply for Basic level internships
  • Year 3+ students can apply for all levels
  • Can accept only one placement offer
  • Must match the preferred major of the internship
Since:
2025-11-18

    • canApply

      public boolean canApply()
      Checks if the student can apply for more internships. Students are limited to a maximum of 3 active applications (applications that are not marked as UNSUCCESSFUL).
      Returns:
      true if the student can apply for more internships, false otherwise

    • isEligibleForLevel

      public boolean isEligibleForLevel(String level)
      Checks if the student is eligible for a given internship level based on year of study.
      • Year 1-2: Basic level only
      • Year 3+: All levels (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced)
      Parameters:
      level - the internship level to check eligibility for
      Returns:
      true if the student is eligible for the specified level, false otherwise

    • applyForInternship

      public boolean applyForInternship(Internship internship)
      Submits an application for the specified internship. Performs validation checks before submitting:
      • Verifies student hasn't reached the 3 application limit
      • Checks eligibility for the internship level
      • Ensures the internship is accepting applications
      • Prevents duplicate applications
      Parameters:
      internship - the internship to apply for
      Returns:
      true if the application was successfully submitted, false otherwise

    • viewAppliedInternships

      public void viewAppliedInternships()
      Displays all internships the student has applied for, showing their status, placement confirmation, withdrawal status, and company information.

    • acceptPlacement

      public boolean acceptPlacement(Application application)
      Accepts a placement offer for an approved application.
      • Validates that the application belongs to this student
      • Ensures the application status is SUCCESSFUL
      • Prevents accepting multiple placements
      • Automatically withdraws all other applications
      Parameters:
      application - the application to accept
      Returns:
      true if the placement was successfully accepted, false otherwise

    • requestWithdrawal

      public boolean requestWithdrawal(Application application)
      Requests withdrawal for an application. The withdrawal request must be approved by Career Centre Staff.
      Parameters:
      application - the application to withdraw
      Returns:
      true if the withdrawal request was successfully submitted, false otherwise
